patterns.note: The site uses a high-contrast, limited palette dominated by a vibrant lime green and a deep forest green, creating a bold and energetic feel across all sections.
Large, distinctive serif typography is used for primary headlines, providing a playful yet impactful brand voice that stands out.
Sections are presented as full-width color blocks, creating clear visual separation and a strong, modular rhythm down the page.
The primary navigation bar becomes sticky at the top of the viewport and transitions its background from transparent to a solid dark green upon scrolling.
Content sections are revealed with a subtle fade-up animation as they scroll into view, enhancing content discovery and engagement.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky navigation bar that transitions from transparent to a solid dark green background upon scrolling. Sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, likely a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport. The hero section features a playful, animated monster illustration, implemented using Lottie.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, heavy serif headings (~3-4x body) are paired with smaller, legible sans-serif body text and uppercase sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Pill for primary call-to-action buttons, with sharp corners defining most content blocks and sections.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy vertical spacing between full-width color-blocked sections, creating clear visual breaks, while internal content uses a balanced density.

standout: The combination of the bold, almost aggressive lime green and deep forest green palette with the quirky, large serif typography and the playful monster illustration creates a highly distinctive and memorable brand identity that feels rebellious and energetic, far from a generic health food site. The monster illustration is a key differentiator.
